Two Films' Box Office Performance Contrasted Amidst Reviews

The film 'Other Mommy' grossed $27.5 million at the box office, significantly outperforming 'The Social Reckoning,' which opened to $5.5 million. Despite 'Other Mommy' receiving poor reviews, it generated seven times more revenue than 'The Social Reckoning.'
